kebab_example: aliyun ehpc recover-cluster --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --os-tag CentOS_7.2_64 --account-type nis --scheduler-type pbs --image-owner-alias system --image-id m-bp18133n0335yq0000 --client-version 1.0.76 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecoverCluster

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID. The cluster must be in the Exception state.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the ID and status of a cluster
parameters.help_zh:
指定重置并修复的集群ID。并且，集群状态必须为exception（异常）时才能修复。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID及集群状态
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The tag of the system image.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87213.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87215.html operations to query the image tags supported by Elastic High Performance Computing (E-HPC)
parameters.help_zh:
操作系统镜像标签。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87213.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87215.html查询E-HPC支持的镜像标签
parameters.name: os_tag

parameters.help_en:
The service type of the domain account. Valid values:

*   nis
*   ldap

Default value: nis
parameters.help_zh:
账户服务类型。取值范围：
- nis
- ldap

默认值：nis
parameters.name: account_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the scheduler. Valid values:

*   pbs
*   slurm
*   opengridscheduler
*   deadline

Default value: pbs
parameters.help_zh:
调度服务器类型。取值范围：
- pbs
- slurm
- opengridscheduler
- deadline

默认值：pbs
parameters.name: scheduler_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the image. Valid values:

*   system: public image
*   self: custom image
*   others: shared image

Default value: system
parameters.help_zh:
镜像类型。取值范围：
- system：公共镜像
- self：自定义镜像
- others：共享镜像

默认值：system
parameters.name: image_owner_alias

parameters.help_en:
The image ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87213.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87215.html operations to query the images that are supported by E-HPC
parameters.help_zh:
镜像ID。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87213.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87215.html查询E-HPC可安装的镜像
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en:
The version of the E-HPC client. The default value is the latest version of the client.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87223.html operation to query the latest version of the E-HPC client
parameters.help_zh:
集群所使用的客户端版本号，默认为最新版本。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87223.html查询当前最新客户端版本号
parameters.name: client_version
